_doc: Heroes' own lives between jobs (Systems/Downtime.cs). Once a week (by id) each hero in town with gold to spare does something with it, in this order: buys land and a house of their own (landCost plus landPerLevel a level, paid to the town; then they sleep there instead of the tavern, gain rootLoyalty once and rooted a day after), plays patron (with patron.spare gold over keep and patron.renown, at most once in patron.every days, gives patron.share of it: a forge order made for them from the town's parts, else the next part of a monument, else their god's shrine fund or, if the shrine stands, its favour at favourPerGold; patron.fame renown each), trains (trainPerLevel a level, for trainXp of their next level, at most trainMaxLevel), or buys a stake in a business in town (stake gold into its till, paying back dividend of it a day while the till has it). They can still be called up for any job.
_fortunes: Before the rest, once a week: a hero with retireGold spare, retireLevel and a veteran's record (no fief, no bastion) retires to teach and leaves retireShare of it to the treasury; one with a house and manorCost (plus manorPerLevel a level) buys a manor (a land sale; manorLoyalty once); one with feastSpare spare throws a feast at a tavern every feastEvery days, feastShare of it up to feastMost into the tavern's till.

manors: a manor on the hill with a walled orchard
a fortified manor by the river
a great house off the market square
a stone manor with a tower of its own

holdings: a narrow house on the hill
an old tower by the river
a cottage with a walled garden
a hunting lodge at the forest's edge

lines.land: {hero} buys {holding} for {cost} gold, and sleeps under their own roof between jobs.
lines.train: {hero} pays {cost} gold for a week's hard training with {trainer}.
lines.stake: {hero} buys a stake in {business} for {cost} gold.
lines.forge: {hero} pays {cost} gold for the {shop} to make them {item} from the town's spoils.
lines.monument: {hero} pays {cost} gold out of their own fortune for the {part} of {monument}.
lines.shrine: {hero} gives {cost} gold toward a shrine to {god}.
lines.endow: {hero} endows the shrine of {god} with {cost} gold.
lines.feast: {hero} stands the whole of {tavern} a feast, {cost} gold of roast and ale.
lines.manor: {hero} buys {holding} for {cost} gold, and means to grow old in it.
lines.retire: {hero} hangs up their sword, rich past needing another job, and stays on to teach. They leave {cost} gold to the town.

trainers: a priest who once marched with the crusades
